defs.def: a round vegetable with many layers inside each other and a brown, red or white skin. Onions have a strong smell and flavour. 洋葱；葱头

ex.s: Later, I learnt that the most famous food in Shandong is pancake rolls stuffed with sliced Chinese green onions.
ex.t: 后来，我了解到山东最有名的食物是煎饼卷大葱。

ex.s: The first day he walked into my class, he was dragging his schoolbag behind him and looking bored, but as soon as I set up an experiment to show how the human stomach works using acid and an onion, he gave me his full attention.
ex.t: 他走进我班的第一天，他拖着书包、一副无聊的样子，但当我设置了一个用酸和洋葱来展示人类胃部工作原理的实验时，他立刻全神贯注了。

ex.s: As the soup bubbled slowly over a gas burner in the middle of the table, its surface was covered with a beautiful layer of chillies, Sichuan peppers, spring onions and red oil.
ex.t: 当汤在桌子中央的燃气炉上慢慢冒泡时，汤面上覆盖着一层美丽的辣椒、花椒、葱花和红油。

ex.s: Yet every one had had enough, and the youngest Cratchits, in particular, were steeped in sage and onion to the eyebrows!
ex.t: 然而每个人都吃饱了，尤其是最小的克拉奇家的孩子们，他们满身都是鼠尾草和洋葱的味道，一直淹到眉毛！
